solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Innocent child — baby hugging mother, not half!

indicators.note: one piece wraps its arms round another, so it holds the other inside it

parts.note: a cub is a young animal, a baby bear or fox

indicators.note: the word mother is cut so that its first half is dropped and only its second half survives

parts.note: taken as written before being halved

explanation.surface: A parent coos over an innocent infant, with the mother hugging the baby, as hugs go, quite a lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not half' reads as British slang for 'very much', but here it literally keeps only the second half of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherub is a winged angel-child of art, so by extension any sweet, guileless little one.

clue.text: Tea and silly blather, wasting time

indicators.note: silly suggests letters jumbled into a foolish order
wasting means losing something, so a letter is dropped from the word blather

parts.note: taken as written as the anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses idle chatter over a cuppa as time wasted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wasting time' drops T from BLATHER, leaving BLAHER, which 'silly' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbal is an infusion of leaves or flowers rather than true tea leaves, a tisane.

clue.text: What could be left after an educational division?

definitions.text: What could be left after an educational division?

parts.words: What could be left after an educational division?
parts.note: in a long-division sum at school, the amount left over that does not divide exactly

explanation.surface: Wonders what is left of a school once it has been split up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Educational division' sounds like a department of a school; it is a sum done in class.
explanation.definitionFit: In arithmetic the amount left over after dividing one number into another is given this name.

clue.text: Female taking in by bishop completely — a pretty little creature?

parts.note: B is the chess-notation abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: the female letter is taken in, absorbed by the pieces that follow it

parts.note: utterly means completely, totally

explanation.surface: A woman is being taken in, utterly, by a bishop.
explanation.walkthrough: F goes inside B + UTTERLY, splitting it as B-UTTER-F-LY.
explanation.definitionFit: Its colourful wings make this insect the classic example of a small, lovely flying creature.

clue.text: Playful tot heard pursuing wild animals?

indicators.note: pursuing means following after, so this piece comes second

parts.note: game is wild animals hunted for sport or food

indicators.note: heard signals that a word is pronounced like another spelt differently

parts.note: to tot up is to add, so a tot is a sum

explanation.surface: A frisky toddler is overheard chasing wild beasts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tot' looks like a small child but is SUM, said aloud as SOME.
explanation.definitionFit: Gamesome is a slightly old-fashioned word for frisky, full of fun and inclined to frolic.

clue.text: Wild animal finds stream in Indian location

indicators.note: in places the stream inside the Indian place name

parts.note: Goa is a state on the west coast of India
a rill is a small stream or brook

explanation.surface: A wild creature discovers a brook in some Indian spot.
explanation.definitionFit: This great ape is a large animal of African forests, untamed in its native setting.

clue.text: Scotsman with a wife that may possibly imitate people?

parts.note: Mac is a familiar term for a Scotsman, from the prefix of many Scottish surnames

explanation.surface: A Scot and his spouse who might mimic others.
explanation.definitionFit: This large parrot can learn to copy human speech, mimicking the people it hears.

clue.text: Cheerful lad's sound

indicators.note: sound here means what is heard when something is pronounced

parts.note: sonny is a familiar address for a boy

explanation.surface: A boy is in good health and spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like 'healthy', describing the lad, but it signals the homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: A bright, happy disposition is often compared to fine weather, hence cheery and bright.

clue.text: Italian city's major road leading to minor roads east

indicators.note: leading to puts this piece in front of what follows

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main motorway north from London, its 1 read as the letter I
lanes are narrow country roads

explanation.surface: A map description: a city's motorway runs into small roads to the east.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is a British motorway; the digit 1 doubles as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective for things from Milan, the northern Italian city, so belonging to that city.

clue.text: Advocate for mum when husband's run off

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for

indicators.note: run off means departed, so a letter leaves the word

parts.note: mum is an informal word for mother
H is the standard abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: Someone backs a mother left alone after her husband has fled.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who champions or campaigns on behalf of a cause, pushing it forward, is its backer.

clue.text: Decorative item and source of light in church?

definitions.meaning: an ornamental thing placed on a table or mantelpiece
a wax taper lit at an altar or votive stand

explanation.surface: Describes an ornament that also lights up a place of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A wax stick with a wick is both an ornament and the traditional light at altars.

clue.text: Sea or river flooding American state

indicators.note: a river flooding a place pours into it, so goes inside

parts.note: Maine is the north-eastern US state

explanation.surface: Asks whether the ocean or a river is swamping a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, it means belonging to the ocean, as in sea life.

clue.text: Bird in act of deception near sea level?

indicators.note: in places the bird inside the deceit word

parts.note: lying is telling untruths, deceiving
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A bird is caught out in a lie close to the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Land only slightly above the water is described as flat and not elevated, hence by the shore.

clue.text: Learner given highest grades in workplace

parts.note: L is the learner-driver plate abbreviation
A and B are the top two exam marks

explanation.surface: A student gets top marks at work.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for laboratory, a room where scientists carry out experiments and research.

clue.text: Very crazy — and bristly with it?

definitions.meaning: utterly silly, a British idiom for a foolish person
covered in bristles, like a broom or brush, taken literally

explanation.surface: Someone thoroughly mad and covered in bristles to boot.
explanation.walkthrough: The British simile means very foolish; read literally it describes something as bristly as a brush.
explanation.definitionFit: The British simile 'daft as a brush' means extremely silly or foolish.

clue.text: Be in a car suffering without oxygen? Without oxygen!

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the jumbled letters surround the next piece
suffering suggests something damaged, so the letters are knocked out of order

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: Sitting in a stuffy car, someone gasps for air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' first means outside: the anagram of BE IN A CAR goes round O; the second 'Without oxygen' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Biologists use this for processes or organisms that live or work in the absence of air.

clue.text: Greek character toiled breaking stone

parts.note: rho is the 17th letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: breaking suggests something smashed, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Greek worker labours at smashing rock.
explanation.definitionFit: A rose-red variety of garnet used as a gemstone, so a kind of precious mineral.

clue.text: After endless acclaim heartless murderer gets bolder

indicators.note: after puts the second piece behind the first
endless means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a cheer is a shout of acclaim

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letters are cut out

parts.note: a killer is a murderer

explanation.surface: Following applause that never ends, a cold-blooded killer grows more daring.
explanation.definitionFit: More impudent or brazen, showing greater nerve and disrespect, is a kind of extra daring.

clue.text: Fruit that can be mushed into hot creamy rot

indicators.note: mushed means squashed to a pulp, so the letters are pounded into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Some produce could be squashed into a warm, creamy mess.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round variety of tomato, botanically a berry and so classed among fruits.

clue.text: Grass is dry reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means as told by word of mouth, so how something is pronounced

parts.note: wry means dryly humorous

explanation.surface: News reports that the lawn is parched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dry' suggests parched, but here it is wry, as in dry humour.
explanation.definitionFit: A cereal plant of the grass family grown for grain, whisky and hay.

clue.text: Mollusc's head swallowed by old fish

indicators.note: swallowed by means taken inside the following pieces

parts.note: a cod is a fish
the top is the head of something

explanation.surface: A sea creature's head is gulped down by an aged fish.
explanation.definitionFit: An eight-armed cephalopod such as the octopus belongs to the mollusc group.

clue.text: Dennis maybe providing chaps with excellent service

parts.note: chaps are men
an ace is an unreturnable serve in tennis

explanation.surface: Someone named Dennis gives fellows a superb serve at tennis.
explanation.walkthrough: Dennis the Menace is a naughty boy in the long-running British comic the Beano.
explanation.definitionFit: The Beano's Dennis is the best-known troublemaker given this name, an example of a pest.

clue.text: Feeble technology given to salesperson at end of month

indicators.note: at end of puts the salesperson after the month
given to means attached after the salesperson

parts.note: Dec is the abbreviation for December
a rep is a sales representative
IT is information technology

explanation.surface: Weak computer kit is handed to a sales rep as the month closes.
explanation.definitionFit: Worn out and weakened by old age or long use, so lacking strength.

clue.text: One form of music or another that's doubly good

indicators.note: that's introduces a change to the other music word

parts.note: another form of music: a raga is a traditional Indian melodic form

indicators.note: doubly means the letter is given twice

explanation.surface: Declares that one style of music or another is twice as good.
explanation.walkthrough: RAGA with its single G for good made doubly good gives GG.
explanation.definitionFit: A Jamaican dance style mixing reggae with hip-hop, so one musical genre.

clue.text: Sit in upper chamber

indicators.note: in says the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: An instruction to take a seat in the upstairs room or upper house.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle on a raised spot, as a bird does on a branch, is to rest seated.

clue.text: Island adventurer making fortune from mines

definitions.meaning: a Greek isle in the Dodecanese
Cecil, the imperialist who grew rich from South African diamond mines

explanation.surface: An island and a man who struck it rich in mining.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a Greek island and the surname of Cecil, the diamond magnate of colonial Africa.

clue.text: Some player in Germany who shouldn't be in the team?

definitions.text: who shouldn't be in the team

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some foreign player in Germany is an illicit selection for the side.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor fraudulently fielded in place of an eligible one is an impostor in sport.

clue.text: Host of American politician about to be deposed?

indicators.note: deposed means removed from office, so these letters are thrown out

parts.note: a Republican is a member of one of the two main US parties
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Wonders who will host a US politician about to be ousted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to be deposed' reads as one phrase but splits: RE is removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub landlord is the host who welcomes customers to the bar.

clue.text: Broken food item guerrilla fighter's eaten

indicators.note: eaten means swallowed up, so the fighter's name goes inside

parts.note: bread is a staple food
Che Guevara was the Argentine guerrilla leader

explanation.surface: A broken loaf has been devoured by a guerrilla fighter.
explanation.definitionFit: A wall or defence that has been broken through has had a gap made in it.

clue.text: Having company with set of principles carrying little weight

indicators.note: carrying means holding something inside

parts.note: a creed is a system of beliefs
W is the abbreviation for weight

explanation.surface: A firm with its own code of ethics carries little clout.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship or plane provided with staff on board is manned, never travelling alone.
